title: SIR per-unit synergy test results for DrugCombDB (O'Neil and NCI-ALMANAC)
software: SIR R package 0.2.0 (bundled Python implementation sirsyn)
reference_model: Bliss independence on viability, E Y_ij = E Y_i0 E Y_0j, control normalized to 1

null_tested.ONEIL: no synergy in any combination cell relative to the reported single-agent curves, which are held fixed
null_tested.ALMANAC: no synergy in any combination cell (Bliss independence on viability, single agents measured on the same plate)

labels: no binary synergy labels; use p- and q-values within the declared testing family

columns.name: study
columns.description: ONEIL or ALMANAC (DrugCombDB source study)

columns.name: unit_id
columns.description: analysis unit. O'Neil: drugA|drugB|cell_line|batch{0,1} (four replicate blocks); ALMANAC: DrugCombDB experiment id (one plate)

columns.name: drug_row
columns.description: drug on the rows (dose index i), DrugCombDB name

columns.name: drug_col
columns.description: drug on the columns (dose index j), DrugCombDB name

columns.name: cell_line
columns.description: cell line (DrugCombDB)

columns.name: batch
columns.description: O'Neil batch (0, or 0 and 1 for the 315 drug pair and cell line groups measured twice); empty for ALMANAC

columns.name: family
columns.description: Benjamini-Hochberg testing family: study, cell line and (O'Neil) batch

columns.name: design
columns.description: analysis design. P: replicate blocks with the reported single-agent curves held fixed; S: single plate with single agents measured on the plate

columns.name: null_tested
columns.description: null hypothesis of the SIR statistic for this unit

columns.name: experiment_ids
columns.description: contributing DrugCombDB block ids

columns.name: n_replicates
columns.description: replicate plates analyzed (4 O'Neil blocks; 1 ALMANAC plate)

columns.name: doses_row_uM
columns.description: row-drug doses analyzed, including zero, uM, ';'-separated

columns.name: doses_col_uM
columns.description: column-drug doses analyzed, including zero, uM, ';'-separated

columns.name: control_raw
columns.description: raw control well (Response / 100); every plate is divided by its control

columns.name: edge_row_top
columns.description: row-drug single-agent viability at its top dose (O'Neil: reported curve)

columns.name: edge_col_top
columns.description: column-drug single-agent viability at its top dose (O'Neil: reported curve)

columns.name: activity
columns.description: activity: mean of 1 - viability over the combination wells (O'Neil: of the replicate means at each well, after the replicate screen)

columns.name: activity_all_wells
columns.description: mean of 1 - viability over all non-control wells

columns.name: mean_bliss_prediction
columns.description: mean over combination cells of the Bliss prediction a_hat_i b_hat_j (isotonic single-agent fits)

columns.name: mean_excess
columns.description: mean viability Bliss excess on raw wells, Y_i0 Y_0j - Y_ij averaged over combination cells (positive: more killing than Bliss). ALMANAC: the cell average of the plate. O'Neil: the block-level estimate, the average over the four plates of each plate's cell average (the estimate of the companion block-level t test); it equals the cell average of the replicate means when no replicate value was screened (n_screened = 0)

columns.name: mean_excess_se
columns.description: standard error of mean_excess from the companion test (O'Neil: block-level, conditional on the reported single-agent curves)

columns.name: companion_test
columns.description: companion mean test (O'Neil: block-level t, 3 df; ALMANAC: V2Sp)

columns.name: companion_t
columns.description: companion t statistic

columns.name: companion_df
columns.description: companion degrees of freedom

columns.name: p_companion
columns.description: one-sided p-value of the companion test (null: no synergy on average)

columns.name: q_companion
columns.description: BH q-value of p_companion within family

columns.name: p_companion_relnull
columns.description: companion p-value against the within-family empirical null (relative null: stronger than typical for the family)

columns.name: q_companion_relnull
columns.description: BH q-value of p_companion_relnull within family

columns.name: fixed_edge_t
columns.description: O'Neil only: fixed-edge viability t with the cross-fitted block-shift variance divided by 4 (15 df)

columns.name: p_fixed_edge
columns.description: O'Neil only: one-sided p-value of fixed_edge_t

columns.name: fixed_edge_block_var
columns.description: O'Neil only: block-shift variance component used by fixed_edge_t

columns.name: p_mean_boot
columns.description: p-value of the raw mean excess calibrated on the reference plates of the SIR statistic

columns.name: t_std
columns.description: the SIR statistic T_SIR = sum over combination cells of ((a_hat_i b_hat_j - mu_hat_ij) / s(a_hat_i b_hat_j))_+^2, mu_hat the 2D isotonic fit

columns.name: p_tstd
columns.description: p-value of the SIR statistic (plug-in parametric bootstrap at exact Bliss; B = 9,999 when a stage-1 p-value was <= 0.05, otherwise B = 399)

columns.name: p_tstd_stage1
columns.description: stage-1 p-value of the SIR statistic (B = 399)

columns.name: mc_stage
columns.description: Monte Carlo stage reported (1 or 2)

columns.name: mc_B
columns.description: reference plates behind p_tstd and p_scan

columns.name: q_tstd
columns.description: BH q-value of p_tstd within family

columns.name: p_tstd_floored
columns.description: ALMANAC only: p_tstd floored at 1 / (2 x bank pool + 1), the resolution of the plate-difference noise bank

columns.name: q_tstd_floored
columns.description: ALMANAC only: BH q-value of p_tstd_floored within family

columns.name: bank_pool_sets
columns.description: eligible noise-bank sets (potency stratum, other half of the cell lines)

columns.name: p_scan
columns.description: region scan global p-value (single-step max-T over high-dose rectangles and 2x2 blocks)

columns.name: p_scan_stage1
columns.description: stage-1 region scan p-value

columns.name: top_region
columns.description: region with the smallest adjusted p-value ('i,j' cells, original dose indices)

columns.name: top_region_type
columns.description: rectangle (high-dose) and/or 2x2 block

columns.name: top_region_z
columns.description: standardized raw-well region sum of top_region

columns.name: top_region_p_adj
columns.description: familywise-adjusted p-value of top_region (within the matrix)

columns.name: fragility_cell
columns.description: ALMANAC plates with p_tstd <= 0.05: most influential combination cell

columns.name: fragility_cell_p
columns.description: p_tstd with that cell set to missing

columns.name: fragility_cell_share
columns.description: share of the SIR statistic contributed by that cell

columns.name: fragility_sa_dose
columns.description: most influential single-agent dose (drug, index)

columns.name: fragility_sa_p
columns.description: p_tstd with that dose row or column dropped

columns.name: fragility_sa_share
columns.description: share of the SIR statistic removed by dropping it

columns.name: n_dropped_doses
columns.description: single-agent doses dropped because the single-agent well was missing (the dose row or column is removed)

columns.name: n_missing_cells
columns.description: missing combination wells

columns.name: n_screened
columns.description: O'Neil: replicate values removed by the replicate screen (more than 5 model SDs from the median of the other replicates)

columns.name: screened
columns.description: screened values: (i,j), replicate and distance in model SDs

columns.name: reference_flags_per_plate
columns.description: mean screened values per reference plate (the same screen is applied to the reference)

columns.name: companion_degenerate
columns.description: companion SE zero or not finite (p-value is NaN)

columns.name: log_notes
columns.description: data-handling and reference notes (noise-bank stratum, pool size, cross-fitting group)

columns.name: seed_entropy
columns.description: seed entropy of the fit (reruns reproduce the unit exactly)
